parsed.name: IQ波形文件转换工具
parsed.description: 用于读写和打包 IQW、WV、IQ.tar 等 IQ 基带波形文件的软件工具，常用于实验室中矢量信号发生器或其他射频仪器的离线波形准备、数据交换与文件格式转换。
parsed.description_en: A software utility for reading, writing, and packaging IQ baseband waveform files such as IQW, WV, and IQ.tar. It is commonly used in laboratories for offline waveform preparation, data exchange, and file format conversion for vector signal generators and related RF instruments.
